paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Distribution of Pass@1 accuracy of Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct on MATH-500, divided into five bins.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of Pass@1 accuracy for the Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct model on the MATH-500 benchmark, categorized into five distinct bins along the horizontal axis labeled “Pass@1,” which ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. The vertical axis, labeled “Percentage,” is scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. Each bar represents a bin’s percentage of total results: the bar at 0.0 is labeled 11.2% and has a height corresponding to approximately 0.112; the bar at 0.2 is labeled 3.4% and reaches approximately 0.034; the bar at 0.4 is also labeled 3.4% and reaches approximately 0.034; the bar at 0.6 is labeled 5.8% and reaches approximately 0.058; and the bar at 1.0 is labeled 76.2% and reaches approximately 0.762. A red dashed vertical line is positioned at 0.8, and a red text annotation indicates the mean value is 0.82. The bars are colored light blue and are not sorted; they are presented in ascending order of their Pass@1 bin value from left to right. The bar at 1.0 is the tallest, visually dominating the chart, while the bar at 0.0 is the shortest. There are no additional visual emphasis or annotations beyond the labels and the mean indicator.
